### INSTRUCTOR WORKSHOPS

Our Workshops include everything you need to ensure  a successful classroom project. You’ll receive guidance for teaching mechanics and electricity, and you’ll build the Switch EV from the ground up, just like your students will.

Workshops

### Switch Electric Vehicle Programs

Students work together to assemble a road-ready electric vehicle following clear instructions. Our re-usable kit includes the chassis, DC or Permanent Magnet drive system, battery, all required wiring, lights, seat, seat-belt and windscreen

EV Programs

### CLASSROOM CURRICULUM

The Switch Lab™ is an all-inclusive, turn-key program curriculum options. Designed to be adaptable for a range of courses and schedules. It supports STEM, CTE and Common Core in one package.

### INSTRUCTOR WORKSHOPS

Prepare to teach the skills students need for the modern EV workforce. Our workshops train instructors in high-voltage safety, EV components, electrical systems, diagnostics, and full vehicle assembly through a hands-on build experience. The 5 day workshop includes ASE xEV materials.
